properties.content:

Nearest City: Nome, AK
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: WASTE OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 1 gallons
RECEIVED REPORT FROM NACHIK VESSEL THAT OIL SHEEN WAS APPARENT IN HARBOR. UPON INVESTIGATION IT BECAME OBVIOUS THAT THE VESSEL "RUSTLER" HAD BEEN PUMPING THEIR ENGINE ROOM BASED ON GARDEN HOSE/PUMP AND 5 GALLON BUCKET CONTAINING OILY MIXTURE WAS ON DECK. SUSPECT THAT RUSTLER WAS PUMPING ENGINE ROOM DURING THE PREVIOUS EVENING WHEN A PORTION OF THE LIQUID WAS DISCHARGED INTO THE HARBOR. OWNER DENIES THIS OCCURRED BUT VESSEL WAS LISTING TO PORT FOR SEVERAL WEEKS UP TO THE POINT OF ALLEGED PUMPING. VESSEL IS NOW SITTING SOMEWHAT LEVEL. REPORTS FROM INDIVIDUALS THAT ENGINE ROOM FLOOR WAS OBSERVED TO BE FULL OF OILY/WATER MIXTURE AS OF YESTERDAY.

THERE IS A RAINBOW SHEEN OUTSIDE OF THE CONTAINMENT AREA THE VEHICLE CAME TO REST AT 8 CENTER ST. SANDY HOOK, CT.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.796549, -83.975014 (Approximated from ZIP)
Reported Spill Volume: 300 gallons
Report Description
NOTIFIED AT 11:04 AM OF HYDRAULIC RELEASE FROM SOUTH INGOT FACILITY STORM SEWER THAT LEADS TO THE PLANT'S PROCESS WATER OUTFALL 006. A SHEEN WAS SEEN AT THE OUTFALL BASIN, BUT NO SHEEN WAS SEEN ON THE RECEIVING STREAM. HOWEVER, THE HYDRAULIC OIL HAD COAGULATED AND DROPPED OUT TO THE BOTTOM OF THE BASIN. THERE WERE SOME SPOTS OF THE COAGULATED OIL SEEN IN THE RIP RAP BELOW THE OUTFALL DISCHARGE. WATER FROM THE HEAT EXCHANGER WAS DIVERTED TO PREVENT IT FROM RE-ENTERING THE STORM SEWER. BOOMS AND PADS HAVE BEEN PLACED AT THE OUTFALL TO HELP COLLECT ANY OIL THAT MAY BE FLOATING. A CONTRACTOR HAS BEEN BROUGHT ONSITE TO PUMP OUT THE MATERIAL AND CLEAN THE BASIN

properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 908130
Incident Time: 2009-06-10 13:10:00
Nearest City: Greensboro, NC
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: RADIOACTIVE MATERIAL
Medium Affected: NON-RELEASE (N/A)
Suspected Responsible Party: PROCTER & GAMBLE
Skytruth Analysis
THE GAUGE WAS ON A LINE THAT WAS BEING DISASSEMBLED AND CLEARED OUT. THE LICENSEE HAD TOLD THE CONTRACTOR TO LEAVE THE PART OF THE LINE WITH THE GAUGE UNTIL INDUSTRIAL DYNAMICS HAD A CHANCE TO REMOVE THE DEVICE. HOWEVER, THE DEVICE WAS NOT REMOVED AND THE LINE WAS SENT OFF FOR DISPOSAL. THE DEVICE WAS PHYSICALLY REMOVED FROM THE SITE ON OR ABOUT MAY 28, 2009. THE LICENSEE DISCOVERED THE MISSING DEVICE ON JUNE 09, 2009 THE DISPOSED-OF MATERIAL WAS SENT TO DH GRIFFIN IN GREENSBORO NC THEY HAVE BEEN CONTACTED AND ARE IN THE PROCESS OF SORTING AND SEARCHING FOR THE DEVICE. DH GRIFFIN SAYS THERE IS A GOOD CHANCE THAT THE DEVICE IS STILL AT THE SCRAPYARD AS THE SS MATERIAL RECEIVED FROM PG SHOULD BE IN ONE OF TWO PILES STILL AT THE YARD.

CALLER IS REPORTING THAT 200 GALLONS OF #2 HOME HEATING OIL SPILLED IN THE BASEMENT AND DISCHARGED TO WETLANDS AND THEN TO AN UNNAMED BROOK THAT DISCHARGES TO THE DEERFIELD RIVER. THE RETENTION WALL FELL DUE TO A HEAVY RAIN EVENT AND THE WALL COLLAPSED ONTO THE STORAGE TANK. THERE WAS ALSO A DRAINAGE SYSTEM FAILURE CAUSING THE MATERIAL TO BE PUMPED TO THE WETLANDS AND WATERWAY.
